I live in an apartment and am not allowed to store my bike on our balcony. We have an area of wall where my roommate and I can each store a bike if we were to do it vertically, preferably as close to the wall as possible. Does anyone have a recommendation for an indoor storage rack for two bikes?

There's a floor to ceiling type of rack which is basically a pole with hooks. The pole expands to press against the floor and the ceiling, keeping it firmly in place. You can then hang 2 bikes from it. I'd guess that it's probably the most common type of multi-bike indoor rack.

example_1

example_2

Another design is shaped like an upside down U, and achieves a similar effect.

example_1

example_2

That one is called the Michelangelo 2 bike gravity stand. It just leans up against the wall.

With either rack, there's probably a fair chance of both bikes getting knocked onto the floor at the same time. I'd go with the second one. It just looks more aesthetically pleasing than the pole style, and two legs are probably better than one. Plus you have the option to screw it into the wall to make it more secure.
I've seen a pair of padded hooks that spread out from the wall, suspending a bike fairly well while being very minimal in space. Some even fold upwards when there's no bike on them.
